### rotate.13

Rotate all characters in *x* by 13 positions. This is a simple method to
create spoiler text that is unreadable at first glance, but can easily
be decrypted manually.

Alias: `rot13`

Stack effects:
```
( x:Text -- Text )
```

Example:

| Input                      | Stack             
|----------------------------|-------------------
| `'Behind the tree!' rot13` | `Oruvaq gur gerr!`
| `rot13`                    | `Behind the tree!`
